description: Source code for VisionCameraCodeScanner class implementing barcode scanning using MLKit, including image processing, barcode detection, and conversion functions.

classes.name: VisionCameraCodeScanner
classes.description: A class for scanning barcodes from camera frames using MLKit, with support for inverted images and various barcode formats.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Processes a camera frame to detect barcodes, including optional inverted image processing.

methods.name: createScanner
methods.description: Initializes the barcode scanner with specified formats.

methods.name: convertContent
methods.description: Converts a Barcode object into a dictionary with detailed information.

methods.name: convertBarcode
methods.description: Converts a Barcode object into a dictionary including corner points, display value, raw value, content, and format.

methods.name: invert
methods.description: Inverts the colors of a CIImage to handle inverted barcode images.
